rawContent: Heading to Adelaide Festival of Ideas to speak with @JaneCaro on a #metoo panel for @newmatilda Looking forward to catching up with @sparkkechange and uni students while in town too!

Instead of talking about how to make men 'feel' more comfortable in the #MeToo debate, we need to talk about how to 'make' women safer in their actual lives. If that means making men uncomfortable so be it. No one ever chooses 2 give away their power. U have 2 take it from them.

‘How money helped me escape an arranged marriage’  Shivani Gopal
